rubrics.justification: Generally reasonable blastocyst assessment and correctly notes the grading-text discrepancy, but it leans on uncertain visual interpretation, adds speculative debris/fragments, and does not clearly describe visible zona or image-limited features.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior IVF/live births, sperm parameters, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is mostly logical and structured, with conclusions broadly supported; minor issues include overinterpreting AMH as oocyte quality and somewhat optimistic probability uplift from prior live births.

Largely consistent with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF practice, including attention to endometrium and embryo quality, though some statements about prognosis and grading interpretation are a bit simplified.
Provides some practical guidance such as proceeding with transfer and checking endometrium, but the recommendations are incomplete/truncated and lack detailed future-cycle planning.
